description: A data analysis toolkit for profiling dataset quality, planning reproducible cleaning, engineering analytical features, writing Oracle SQL, and preparing Tableau reports.

defaultPrompt: Audit this dataset for quality issues and report counts with clear denominators.
Plan reproducible cleaning steps for this dataset and explain how to validate the results.
Write an Oracle SQL query for this analysis using the schema and business rules I provide.
interface.longDescription: Helps data analysts inspect dataset quality and prepare reliable analysis. Skills cover profiling and validation, reproducible cleaning, feature engineering, Oracle SQL, and Tableau metrics and dashboards. Outputs are guidance to review; the plugin does not connect to databases or modify files.

name: data-analyst-toolkit
